recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair, wearing a black velvet lace-up corset and gold leaf-style necklace, set against a pale, subtly textured cream background with a single line of red typography at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a low-contrast, desaturated background
Horizontal typographic line anchoring the top of the frame
Symmetry between the subject's pose and the central vertical axis
Material contrast between matte velvet, metallic jewelry, and soft skin tones
coreInvariants: Dotted line connecting left and right text elements
Pale yellow/cream background with marble-like or wood-grain texture
Deep black velvet texture in the garment
Warm studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally aligned, occupying the middle 60% of the horizontal frame, from waist to top of head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the gold leaf necklace serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the necklace and corset lacing, then upward to the red text line at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the subject, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low saturation; high value contrast provided by the black subject elements.

letterConstructionRules: Small x-height relative to cap height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both left and right text blocks for consistency.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dotted line connecting text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Humanist qualities and clean geometry typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 1970s disco-style voluminous hair, wearing a black velvet lace-up corset and a gold leaf necklace. The background should be a pale cream color with a very subtle, light wood-grain or marble texture. The lighting should be warm and soft.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of red sans-serif text at the very top of the frame. Place one phrase on the far left and another on the far right, connected by a horizontal row of red dots.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a vibrant red?
Is the background texture subtle enough not to distract?
Does the dotted line span the gap between the two text blocks?

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text is at the top edge and not overlapping the hair.
Ensure the velvet looks tactile and deep black.
Check that the background texture is visible but low-contrast.
Verify the red dots are evenly spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Pale Textured Backdrop + Top-Aligned Split Typography + Dotted Connector Line
